title: Persist lane watching in the harness
happened: Lane watching was implemented in session scratch scripts and lost at handoff.
expected: The harness owns durable lane watching and reports state changes across sessions.
repro: Start a synthetic lane, monitor it with a scratch loop, then resume in a fresh session. The loop is absent from the harness CLI.
output: Owner-reported observation; no raw output retained.
proposal: Provide a harness watch command that records lane progress and surfaces blocked states. Check the watch branch before sending.

title: Resolve worker models from harness profiles at dispatch
happened: An orchestrator chose a worker model from session memory instead of the harness profile; the user corrected it.
expected: Every dispatch resolves its model and effort from the merged harness profile table.
repro: Override a profile in a synthetic overlay and dispatch using a remembered model. Compare the dispatch with the overlay value.
output: Owner-reported correction; no raw output retained.
proposal: Resolve and validate the profile at the launch boundary. Check the model-router branch before sending.

title: Recognize Codex question dialogs as blocked lanes
happened: A Codex lane displaying a question dialog was not recognized as blocked.
expected: The lane is shown as blocked and the question is surfaced to the user.
repro: Use a synthetic Codex detection snapshot containing: ? 1 question ⇧← to answer. Query lane status.
proposal: Recognize the question dialog in blocked-state detection and add a snapshot regression case.

title: Explain unavailable test services before gate failure cascades
happened: A gate reported over 700 failures because the test database was unavailable, without identifying the shared cause.
expected: The gate identifies an unavailable test prerequisite and gives a harness-level recovery hint.
repro: Configure a synthetic gate requiring a test database. Stop that synthetic service and run the gate.
output: Owner-reported failure cascade; no product test output retained.
proposal: Support optional overlay prerequisite checks and summarize a failed prerequisite before running dependent suites.

title: Archive frozen manifests for authorized test amendments
happened: freeze refused to replace an existing manifest; each user-authorized test amendment needed a manual archive step.
expected: An explicit amendment records user authorization and archives the earlier manifest before freezing the amended tests.
repro: Freeze a synthetic failing test manifest. Amend the test with user approval and run freeze for the same unit.
output: Owner-reported refusal; no raw output retained.
proposal: Add an explicit amendment command or option that preserves prior evidence and records the authorization.

title: Keep unrelated agents outside a run lane limit
happened: The default lane limit of three counted unrelated agents, preventing a run from opening its own lane.
expected: A run can select a limit scoped to its own agents without interfering with unrelated sessions.
repro: With three unrelated synthetic agents present, start a new run lane under workspace counting and compare with count: run.
output: Owner-reported limit behavior; no raw output retained.
proposal: Version 1.3.0 already supports project.json → lanes.count: run. Review the default and discoverability; avoid filing a duplicate fix.
